plugins.description: TradeBlocks analysis skills for Option Omega backtests and live trading portfolios. Includes strategy profiling, health checks, double calendar workshopping, exit trigger simulation, walk-forward analysis, regime performance, risk assessment, strategy comparison, and parameter optimization. The TradeBlocks MCP server is installed separately.
